subject.title: Incomplete turn with tool call and payloads=0 is replayUnsafe and may poison session state

question: For replay-unsafe stopReason=stop tool turns with payloads=0, should OpenClaw retry/fallback when the current attempt is provably side-effect-free, only quarantine/diagnose them, or fold this into the older replay-unsafe incomplete-turn umbrella?
rationale: The current fail-closed behavior protects against duplicating tool side effects, but field evidence shows it turns intermittent provider/model empty turns into hard agent or cron failures; deciding the retry versus quarantine boundary is a maintainer product/safety choice.

options.title: Approve current-attempt recovery plus quarantine
options.body: Add a current-attempt safety boundary for retry/fallback and persist clear quarantine/diagnostic state for unsafe incomplete tool turns.

options.title: Quarantine only
options.body: Keep replay-unsafe turns fail-closed and improve durable repair records, diagnostics, and user guidance without adding automatic retry/fallback.

options.title: Fold into older umbrella
options.body: Treat the remaining work as part of https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/88657 and close or cross-link this issue after preserving the new field evidence there.

recommendation.title: Approve current-attempt recovery plus quarantine
recommendation.body: Add a current-attempt safety boundary for retry/fallback and persist clear quarantine/diagnostic state for unsafe incomplete tool turns.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged history and review ownership around the incomplete-turn retry safety boundary make this the strongest available routing candidate.
